content: After the storm has soaked the earth, the ground hardens into stone.
author: Japanese Proverbs
sourceWork: Ame futte ji katamaru (雨降って地固まる)
explanation: Rainstorms churn the soil into muddy, chaotic mire. Yet once the clouds pass and the sun returns, the compressed earth becomes firmer and more unshakeable than before. Hardship is the natural compaction process that creates enduring human strength.
practicalInsight: When an argument or trial shakes your foundations, look for the deeper stability that honest confrontation will bring once the emotional rain ceases.
reflectionPrompt: What past period of grief or turmoil felt like destruction at the time, but ultimately hardened your character into solid rock?
